{{Quote|Merik is truly a nice man, and I'd hate to see anything worse happen to him. It's my job to make certain a client is taken care of, you see? That's why I called for medical before he twitched.|Naytha Alutana, on Merik Darou|<ref name="Oblivion's Kiss">{{LivingForce|Oblivion's Kiss}}</ref>}}
'''Naytha Alutana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] escort who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Alutana began life as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]; she was eventually purchased from a slaving pen by [[Thurm Loogg]], a senior [[Metatheran Cartel]] official, and she entered the service of the Cartel. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Loogg sent Alutana to act as an escort for [[Merik Darou]], the assistant of [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], as part of a plan developed by Loogg to put the senator into his debt. Alutana spent some time with Darou on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and she was with him when he entered a coma as a result of consuming some tainted [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]]. The Twi'lek immediately called some private medical personnel and ensured that they took care of Darou, then traveled to a [[Metatheran Cartel's office-cruiser|Cartel officer-cruiser]] to report to Loogg on Darou's condition.

Lavina Wren hired the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of local freelance agents, to track down the [[drug dealer]] from which Darou had purchased the tainted ryll, and the agents flew to the officer-cruiser to meet with Alutana. Loogg and the Twi'lek met with the agents in Loogg's personal office, and Loogg agreed to allow Alutana to assist the agents with their investigation. She then provided them with the address of [[Kelkan D'vrosh]], the dealer who had sold the ryll to Darou.

==Personality and traits==
Despite being forced into slavery, Alutana was genuinely helpful and willing to serve others. However, she was fiercely loyal to Loogg due to the fact that he had rescued her from slavery, so she was only willing to help the freelance agents once Loogg had directed her to do so.
